description: OR-group filter demonstrating OR:<n>: prefix syntax. Reads as: (rush_request=Rush AND status=NEW AND team in my_teams) OR (rush_request=Rush AND assignee=me AND status=NEW). Empirically verified against a surveyed OPTASK rush-queue report.
notes: OR:<n>: prefix attaches BEFORE everything, including DE: and _Mod
Group ID is numeric (1) — distinct from EXISTS which uses letters (a/b/c)
All OR:1:* keys are AND-joined internally; the whole group is OR'd with the bare keys
Multi-value via TAB-separator: $$USER.teamIDs is a session token that resolves to a tab-separated list at runtime
DE: prefix is KEPT on filter keys (asymmetric — see 05-gotchas.md #10)
